tickets.title: Session ids, land repair causes and retention in job records
tickets.what:
Spec `.scratch/toktrack-facts/spec.md`, D-2026-11-23-01. (1) Record `sessions[]` (`{harness, id,
path?}`) on `job.json` for every native session a job runs, for pi (session file; the job's `sessions/` links
and headless session files), Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity workers, including repair continuations; copy it
into the archive line. (2) Extend the archived `land` with per-repair `{step_kind, step, outcome}` (`conflict`
for cherry-pick, `gate` otherwise) and per-rerun `{step, passed_unchanged}` taken from the flow records; keep the
existing counts. (3) Add `retry_of` to the archive line. (4) Retention keeps a job directory whose native session
file exists nowhere else (headless pi) for at least 7 days after it settles; nothing else changes. Synthetic data
only in tests.

acceptance.text: Unit tests: sessions[] for a pi tab job, a headless sonic, a Claude CLI job and a repaired continuation
Archive line carries sessions[], retry_of and per-repair / per-rerun causes for a flow with a conflict repair and a flaky rerun
Retention test: headless job kept 7 days, a pi tab job whose session lives in `~/.pi` follows today's rule
docs/reference.md (EN/ZH) describes the new archive fields

tickets.title: Experiment tag at hud_create
tickets.what:
Spec `.scratch/toktrack-facts/spec.md`, D-2026-11-23-01. Optional `experiment` and `arm` strings
(each ≤ 64 chars) on `hud_create`, single and batch, kept by `retry_of` and repairs, stored on `job.json` and in
the archive line. No panel display. Keep the tool-schema growth small (the MCP lean budget): one short
description line.

acceptance.text: Schema accepts and validates both fields; batch items too; retry and repair inherit them
Archive line carries them; MCP schema bytes grow ≤ 200 B (existing schema-size test)

tickets.title: Archive keeps the flow and question facts toktrack reads
tickets.what: Spec `docs/spec.md` §2.3 (evidence beyond the current run; D-2026-11-23-01). Job and flow directories expire after 24 hours (`src/runtime/work-retention.ts:58-105`, `watch-runtime.ts:806-818`), but the archive line misses facts toktrack's HUD pages read. In `src/roles/job-land.ts:60-63` and `src/roles/job-archive.ts:87-100`, add: the land flow's `created_at` and per-step outcomes, including flaky-rerun command names (toktrack `workflow.rs:196,213`, `facts.rs:112`); the job's `dispatcher` when known (`facts.rs:215`); `output_written`; and per-question asked/answered times (`workflow.rs:285`). Additive fields only, no report text. Details: `~/projects/MyHUD/tmp/tasks/spec-pivot/review-carbon.md` §2 item 5.

acceptance.text: Unit test: an archived line for a landed job with a flaky rerun and one answered question carries flow `created_at`, step outcomes with the flaky command name, `output_written` and the question times
Older archive lines without these fields still parse (existing archive tests)
docs/reference.md (EN/ZH) describes the new archive fields; `npm test` passes
